by: tools/sanborn/complete/merge_reads.py: two independent reads, a pick only where they agree within 60 px

bends.note: turns north-east to climb to Colerain Avenue; south side cut by plate edge
diagonal from the north-west turns to run east
turns a little more to the south-west on the way down to Blue Rock
west end turns north-west as a 25 ft leg up to Joe Williams Street
north-west side swings north and the street widens into Blue Rock Street

ends.note: north end closed at factory ground
60 ft stub east of Lakeman stops at a property line (green band)
west end; only a narrow unnamed passage (about 9 ft) runs on north-west to Joe Williams Street near 7715,3430
60 ft stub east of Lakeman Street stops at the green property boundary

notes: Centres read from block corners; solid pipe lines and dashed sewers inside the streets ignored. Lakeman x Chase: Chase's north side is off the top of the scan, centre taken on the sewer line / lettering (y about 45), uncertain by 20-30 px. The street meeting Hanfield at 7423,1172 is printed only 'ST.' north of Hanfield and 'WITLER' south of it; taken as Witler Street throughout; its crossing with Chase is off the scan. Hanfield is printed only 'STREET' in this strip, Blue Rock without suffix, Cooper as 'COOPER' (suffix not seen in strip). Hoffner jogs across Colerain: the 55 ft west arm's centre line meets Colerain's at about 8086,5319, the 60 ft east arm's at about 8028,5218; one crossing recorded at the middle of the four corners. Powers likewise: west arm (coming up from the south-west) meets Colerain's centre near 8996,6930, east arm near 9035,6998, the south-east corner is cut by the plate edge; one crossing recorded. McMakin east of Delaney is 12 ft wide (alley width) but printed McMAKIN. Joe Williams meets Blue Rock obliquely; point is where the two centre lines meet, the mouth on Blue Rock's south side lies between about 7925,3165 and 8012,3240. Unnamed alley east of Lakeman near 8046,2185 not picked. Colerain's centre line is straight from 7165,3700 to 9030,6990 (car track runs along it). | Solid lines running inside the streets and branching at crossings are water pipes, not edges; centres were taken between lot lines. The street through Witler and Lakeman carries only the word STREET in this strip; its name is printed far to the west near (3550,310) and reads HANIFIELD (the instructions call it Hanfield Street). Chase Avenue lies along the top plate edge: only its south side, sewer and pipe show, centre taken at the sewer line (about y 38); Lakeman may or may not continue north of it. Witler Street runs off the top of the plate before reaching Chase Avenue. Joe Williams Street meets Blue Rock Street in a wide skew mouth (south-edge corners about 7812,3155 and 8015,3240); the pick is a compromise between the straight centre line extended (about 8053,3156) and the middle of the mouth. The 25 ft leg from Joe Williams Street to the west end of McMakin Street has no separate name and is taken as McMakin Street. McMakin Street is about 25 ft wide west of Delaney and 12 ft wide east of it. Hoffner Avenue is offset at Colerain Avenue: the 55 ft west arm centre meets Colerain at about (8093,5318), the 60 ft east arm at about (8031,5214); one pick at the middle. Powers Street likewise: the diagonal west arm meets Colerain at about (8970,6931), the east arm at about (9007,7003); one pick at the middle. Cooper Street meets Colerain Avenue under the Baltimore and Ohio tracks. WALKER near (9050,2810) is subdivision lettering at the back of lots, not a street. The 10 ft DRAINAGE strip between Witler and Lakeman near y 2030 is not a street.
